collector_methods: --disclosure-file: operator string search of ax get task, count only (recorded, not asserted)
--foreign-markers-file: run IDs, task names and token hashes of the other registered tenant runs
--run-facts: step, concurrency and task counts from the operator's plan (recorded, not asserted)
--targets-file: probe targets and their roles, the tenant's own included
S3 GetObject of the probe's isolation.json (collector client, own credentials; the subject's self-report)
S3 ListBuckets, ListObjectsV2 and GetObject (collector client, own credentials)
gateway access-log extract (--egress-log-file, copied verbatim by the operator), every address replaced by its role

unobserved.tasks_timed: not computable: no tasks_timed in the run facts
unobserved.foreign_secret_in_task_count: not computable: ax get task returned no task
